51.
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the
Constitution, the person holding office as President on the
date of commencement of this Act, so long as he holds the
Office of  President may assign to himself the subjects and
functions  of  Defence,  Mahaweli  Development  and
Environment and determine the Ministries to be in his charge
for that purpose and accordingly, any reference in any written
law  to  the  Minister  to  whom  such  subject  or  function  is
assigned, shall be read and construed as a reference to the
President.
